info.name: vllm
info.description:
Per-model vLLM inference servers defined in ai/vllm/docker-compose.vllm.yml. Each container is an isolated vLLM instance exposing the OpenAI-compatible surface (GET /health, GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/completions) on its own host port. The direct-port surface has NO auth — vLLM does not implement API keys and nothing sits in front of it at the container port. Treat these URLs as internal-only; the production path is through LiteLLM (see the 'Via LiteLLM' folder), which enforces virtual-key auth, rate limits, and logging.

Set the collection variables `vllm_qwen3_8` (default http://localhost:8003), `vllm_qwen3_8_solo` (default http://localhost:8019), `vllm_qwen3_6` (default http://localhost:8002), `vllm_qwen_vl` (default http://localhost:8006), `vllm_muse_glimmer` (default http://localhost:8018), `litellm` (default http://localhost:4001), and `virtual master key`. Direct-port requests inherit `auth: noauth`; requests in 'Via LiteLLM' inherit the collection-level bearer token.

See ai/vllm/VLLM.md for the operator guide (WSL2 UVA warning, HF token setup, adding models, tensor parallelism, the qwen_fixed_chat_template.jinja bug fixes) and ai/litellm/LITELLM.md for issuing virtual keys and the model-alias → upstream mapping.

**Error bodies.** Each endpoint's `#### Schemas` section -- at the end of its first request's description, generated from `vllm.schemas.json` by `scripts/api_schemas.py render` -- documents the fields this stack uses of each request and response body: an open subset of the upstream API. Errors answer the server's own OpenAI-style error object and are not repeated per endpoint.

variable.description: Direct base URL for the qwen3.8 container. Host publish is PORT_VLLM_QWEN38 (default 8003); on ai_shared it's http://qwen3.8:8000. No auth at this surface — anyone with network reach can hit it.

Direct base URL for the qwen3.8-solo container (same Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4 as qwen3.8, single GPU pinned to device 2). Host publish is PORT_VLLM_QWEN38_SOLO (default 8019); on ai_shared it's http://qwen3.8-solo:8000. No auth at this surface.
Direct base URL for the qwen3.6 container. Host publish is PORT_VLLM_QWEN36 (default 8002); on ai_shared it's http://qwen3.6:8000. No auth at this surface.

Direct base URL for the vllm-qwen-vl container (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, vision-language). Host publish is PORT_VLLM_QWEN_VL (default 8006); on ai_shared it's http://vllm-qwen-vl:8000. No auth at this surface.

Direct base URL for the muse-glimmer container (meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B, TP=2 + DFlash). Host publish is PORT_VLLM_MUSE_GLIMMER (default 8018); on ai_shared it's http://muse-glimmer:8000. No auth at this surface.

LiteLLM base URL. Localhost publish is 4001 (PORT_LITELLM); on ai_shared it's http://litellm:4000; behind cloudflared it's https://your-litellm-host. The 'Via LiteLLM' folder routes through this to reach the vLLM containers via the model-alias mapping in litellm_config.yaml.

LiteLLM virtual key (Admin UI → Virtual Keys, or /key/generate API). Sent as `Authorization: Bearer {{virtual master key}}` by the 'Via LiteLLM' folder's auth override. Not used by the direct-port requests.

item.name: qwen3.8
item.description: Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4 (cyankiwi/Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4), served under alias `qwen3.8`. Context: 131072 tokens (--max-model-len). Runs with tensor-parallel-size 2 (shm_size: 8gb required), MTP speculative decoding (num_speculative_tokens=2), qwen3 reasoning parser + qwen3_coder tool parser, and the patched chat template at ai/jinja/qwen_fixed_chat_template.jinja (fixes duplicate <think> blocks, enable_thinking=false crash, and runaway reasoning_effort). If the container is stopped: all requests below fail with `ECONNREFUSED localhost:8003`; the LiteLLM-routed variant returns 500 with a upstream connect error since litellm_config.yaml points `qwen3.8` at http://qwen3.8:8000.

request.description:
Liveness probe. Returns 200 with empty body once vLLM finishes loading the model (start_period: 300s in the compose healthcheck — model download + weight load takes minutes on cold start). Returns connection refused if the container is stopped; returns 503 during startup before the engine is ready.

#### Schemas

The HTTP server starts only after the model has loaded, so a starting container refuses connections rather than answering 503.

Response `200`: no body — the engine is up.

Response `503`: no body — the engine has died (EngineDeadError).

item.name: qwen3.8-solo
item.description: Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4 (cyankiwi/Qwen3.8-27B-AWQ-INT4) — the same model as the `qwen3.8` folder, served under alias `qwen3.8-solo` on a SINGLE GPU (device_ids ['2'], no tensor parallelism) so it can co-run with muse-glimmer on the other two cards. Context: 131072 tokens (--max-model-len), --max-num-seqs 3 (~8 GiB of KV per full-length sequence on one 48 GB card). Same MTP speculative decoding (num_speculative_tokens=2), qwen3 reasoning parser + qwen3_coder tool parser, and patched chat template at ai/jinja/qwen_fixed_chat_template.jinja as qwen3.8. If the container is stopped: all requests below fail with `ECONNREFUSED localhost:8019`; the LiteLLM-routed variant returns 500 with an upstream connect error since litellm_config.yaml points `qwen3.8-solo` at http://qwen3.8-solo:8000. See VLLM.md § Single-GPU qwen3.8.

request.description:
Liveness probe. Returns 200 with empty body once vLLM finishes loading the model (start_period: 300s in the compose healthcheck; weights are shared with qwen3.8 via the vllm_data volume, so a second download is not needed). Returns connection refused if the container is stopped; returns 503 during startup before the engine is ready.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / GET /health*, the first request of this endpoint.

OpenAI-compatible model list. Returns exactly one entry with id `qwen3.8-solo` (from --served-model-name). Use this to confirm the served alias before firing chat/completions — the `qwen3.8` alias belongs to the two-GPU container on port 8003, not this one. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / GET /v1/models*, the first request of this endpoint.

Chat completion against qwen3.8-solo (131072-token context, single GPU). The `model` field must match the --served-model-name (`qwen3.8-solo`) — vLLM 400s on any other value. Supports `chat_template_kwargs: {"reasoning_effort": "low|medium|high|xhigh"}` (default `medium` from the fixed template). Expect roughly half the decode throughput of the TP=2 `qwen3.8` container and a 3-request concurrency cap; excess requests queue. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/chat/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

Legacy text-completion endpoint against qwen3.8-solo (131072-token context). Bypasses the chat template — the prompt is fed to the model verbatim, so reasoning/tool parsers don't fire. Prefer /v1/chat/completions for anything that needs the qwen_fixed_chat_template.jinja fixes. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

item.name: qwen3.6
item.description: Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ-INT4 (cyankiwi/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ-INT4), served under alias `qwen3.6`. Context: 131072 tokens (--max-model-len). Single-GPU (no tensor parallelism), MTP speculative decoding (num_speculative_tokens=2), qwen3 reasoning parser + qwen3_coder tool parser, `enable_thinking=true` and `preserve_thinking=true` set via --default-chat-template-kwargs. Uses the STOCK chat template — if it exhibits duplicate <think> blocks or reasoning-loop symptoms, mount ai/jinja/qwen_fixed_chat_template.jinja like qwen3.8 does. If the container is stopped: all requests below fail with `ECONNREFUSED localhost:8002`; the LiteLLM-routed variant returns 500 upstream connect error.

request.description:
Liveness probe. Returns 200 empty once the engine is ready (start_period: 300s). Returns 503 during model load; connection refused if the container is stopped.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / GET /health*, the first request of this endpoint.

OpenAI-compatible model list. Returns exactly one entry with id `qwen3.6` (--served-model-name). If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / GET /v1/models*, the first request of this endpoint.

Chat completion against qwen3.6 (Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ-INT4, 131072-token context). `model` must be `qwen3.6`. Concurrency is limited: --max-num-seqs 3, so a fourth simultaneous request queues behind the batch. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/chat/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

Legacy text-completion endpoint against qwen3.6 (131072-token context). Bypasses the chat template. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

item.name: vllm-qwen-vl
item.description: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (vision-language), served under the HF repo id `Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct` — no --served-model-name override, so requests must use the full repo path in the `model` field. Context: 8192 tokens (--max-model-len). Runs with --enforce-eager (no CUDA graph capture) and --gpu-memory-utilization 0.40 so it shares the GPU with the qwen3.x containers. Accepts multimodal chat input: `content` can be a list mixing `{"type": "text", "text": "..."}` and `{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/...;base64,..."}}` blocks. If the container is stopped: all requests below fail with `ECONNREFUSED localhost:8006`.

request.description:
Liveness probe. Returns 200 empty once the engine is ready (start_period: 180s — smaller model, faster load). Returns 503 during startup; connection refused if the container is stopped.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / GET /health*, the first request of this endpoint.

OpenAI-compatible model list. Returns one entry with id `Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct` (no --served-model-name override in the compose command). If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / GET /v1/models*, the first request of this endpoint.

Multimodal chat completion against Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (8192-token context — image tokens count against this, so keep image dimensions modest). `model` must be the full HF repo id. Pass images via `image_url` blocks — HTTP(S) URLs are fetched by vLLM (needs egress) or base64 data URIs are decoded inline. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/chat/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

Legacy text-completion endpoint (text-only — no image blocks here, use /v1/chat/completions for multimodal). 8192-token context. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

item.name: muse-glimmer
item.description: Muse-Glimmer-30B (meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B, BF16), served under alias `muse-glimmer`. Meta's dense 29.6B vision-language model, 262144-token context (--max-model-len, above the 131072 trained length — NoPE global layers + 2048-token sliding-window RoPE layers extrapolate without RoPE scaling; VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1). --max-num-seqs 8, a ceiling not a reservation: the measured KV pool (1,103,211 tokens, 4.21x a full-length request) still fits 4 full-length requests at once and longer mixes queue inside vLLM; the classifier takes at most 6 sequences and leaves 2 for chat. --enable-prompt-tokens-details adds usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (prefix-cache hits) to every response. Runs with tensor-parallel-size 2 across two A6000s (shm_size: 8gb required), DFlash speculative decoding via the official meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B-assistant drafter (num_speculative_tokens=15, fixed by the drafter's 16-token block), and the paired muse_glimmer reasoning + tool-call parsers (channel-scoped markers / ATEM tool blocks, not OpenAI JSON). Sampling defaults come from --generation-config auto (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64 — do not run greedy). Mutually exclusive with the qwen3.8 container (same GPU pair at 0.90 utilisation). If the container is stopped: all requests below fail with `ECONNREFUSED localhost:8018`; the LiteLLM-routed variant returns 500 with an upstream connect error since litellm_config.yaml points `muse-glimmer` at http://muse-glimmer:8000. See VLLM.md § Muse Glimmer 30B.

request.description:
Liveness probe. Returns 200 with empty body once vLLM finishes loading the target AND the DFlash drafter (start_period: 600s in the compose healthcheck — cold start pulls ~69 GB then shards across two GPUs). Returns connection refused if the container is stopped; returns 503 during startup before the engine is ready.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / GET /health*, the first request of this endpoint.

OpenAI-compatible model list. Returns exactly one entry with id `muse-glimmer` (from --served-model-name); the DFlash drafter is not listed as a servable model. Use this to confirm the served alias before firing chat/completions. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / GET /v1/models*, the first request of this endpoint.

Chat completion against muse-glimmer (262144-token context). The `model` field must match the --served-model-name (`muse-glimmer`) — vLLM 400s on any other value. Reasoning is returned in `reasoning_content` (muse_glimmer reasoning parser); depth is controlled by a system-prompt line `Reasoning strength: low|medium|high|xhigh`, not a chat_template_kwarg. Tool calls are parsed by the muse_glimmer tool parser into standard `tool_calls`; multiple calls arrive as consecutive assistant messages. Omit temperature/top_p/top_k to inherit Meta's published defaults via --generation-config auto. Output is bit-identical with or without DFlash — speculation only changes latency. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/chat/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

Multimodal chat completion — text + image_url content parts. Up to 4096 visual tokens per image; vLLM's default --limit-mm-per-prompt allows one image per request (400 `At most 1 image(s) may be provided in one request` beyond that — raise the limit in docker-compose.vllm.yml if needed); muse-glimmer runs with `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image": 3}'` for the classifier's reference-guided calls. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/chat/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

Legacy text-completion endpoint against muse-glimmer (262144-token context). Bypasses the chat template — the prompt is fed verbatim, so the muse_glimmer reasoning/tool parsers don't fire and channel markers may appear raw in the output. Prefer /v1/chat/completions. If the container is stopped: connection refused.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

item.name: Via LiteLLM
item.description:
Production path — same chat completion routed through LiteLLM using the model alias. LiteLLM enforces virtual-key auth (`Authorization: Bearer {{virtual master key}}`), applies rate limits, records spend/logging, and maps the alias in litellm_config.yaml (`model_list.model_name: qwen3.6` → `litellm_params.api_base: http://qwen3.6:8000`) to the upstream container over the ai_shared network. Use this path for anything the model or Open WebUI touches; use the direct-port folders only for isolated debugging.

Auth on this folder overrides the collection default to `Bearer {{virtual master key}}`.

request.description:
Same qwen3.8 chat completion, routed through LiteLLM. `model` is the alias from litellm_config.yaml, not the HF repo id. Requires a valid virtual key with access to this alias. If the qwen3.8 container is stopped: LiteLLM returns 500 with an upstream connect error (`connection refused` from http://qwen3.8:8000).

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/chat/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

Same qwen3.8-solo chat completion, routed through LiteLLM. `model` is the alias from litellm_config.yaml (`qwen3.8-solo` -> http://qwen3.8-solo:8000/v1) — deliberately separate from `qwen3.8` so LiteLLM never round-robins onto a container that is down. Requires a valid virtual key with access to this alias. If the qwen3.8-solo container is stopped: LiteLLM returns 500 with an upstream connect error (`connection refused` from http://qwen3.8-solo:8000).

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/chat/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

Same qwen3.6 chat completion, routed through LiteLLM. `model` is the alias. If the qwen3.6 container is stopped: LiteLLM returns 500 with an upstream connect error.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/chat/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

Multimodal chat completion routed through LiteLLM. `model` must match whatever alias litellm_config.yaml maps to vllm-qwen-vl (typically the full HF repo id since the container doesn't set --served-model-name). If the vllm-qwen-vl container is stopped: LiteLLM returns 500 with an upstream connect error.

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/chat/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.

Same muse-glimmer chat completion, routed through LiteLLM. `model` is the alias from litellm_config.yaml (`muse-glimmer` -> http://muse-glimmer:8000/v1), which also injects Meta's sampling defaults (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64) and advertises `supports_vision: true`. Requires a valid virtual key with access to this alias. If the muse-glimmer container is stopped: LiteLLM returns 500 with an upstream connect error (`connection refused` from http://muse-glimmer:8000).

#### Schemas

See *qwen3.8 / POST /v1/chat/completions*, the first request of this endpoint.
